svg.title: Mordor
svg.desc: Ered Lithui encloses Mordor to the north and Ephel Dúath to the west. Udûn is behind the Black Gate. Mount Doom is west and slightly north of Barad-dûr. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: Udûn · the Plateau of Gorgoroth · Orodruin
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
